source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Safe Online Collaboration under 9.1 as printed (PDF 125, printed 121).

blocks.text: Online collaboration allows people to work together using digital tools from any location. It is important to use secure platforms and follow safety rules when sharing files or communicating online. Students learn to work responsibly in virtual groups while protecting personal and school data. Safe collaboration builds trust and ensures productive and respectful teamwork. For example, while using Google Docs for group work, students should share the document only with trusted classmates. They should also set the permission to “View only” instead of “Edit” if others only need to read the document. This helps protect the document from unwanted changes and keeps the work secure.
